##: Strata Terminal + HIP engine (Windows x64). One release tag (Version, e.g. 0.2.18) carries three lockstep version numbers: the Strata app/release version, the Control runtime version (asset strata-control-<ctrl>) and the inference engine version (asset strata-engine-<eng>-windows-x86_64-hip-rdna3). This package installs the Control runtime (flat) and the engine tarball so they always update together. The engine has no top-level folder, so extract_to points at the constant components\engine\_incoming; pre_install then renames it to <version>-<platform>-<backend>[-<variant>] read from engine-component.json, and writes bin\strata-<backend>.cmd exporting STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR / STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND. Keeping the release-versioned directory name lets Strata's own saved-config repair (cfg_paths._newest) find it. checkver reads the signed strata-feed.json and returns the app version plus the two asset basenames; autoupdate rebuilds both release URLs and lets Scoop take each sha256 from the GitHub API digest, so nothing in autoupdate depends on extract_to.
description: Strata 终端版 + HIP 推理引擎（AMD Radeon RX 7000 / 9000 与 Strix Halo，ROCm 打包在包内）：一条命令装好控制端与引擎，模型文件另存
notes: 引擎与控制端都装在本包目录内（apps\strata-hip\<version>），shim 名称为 strata-hip；不写系统环境变量，也不碰 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Strata 下的其它引擎
版本对应：manifest 的 Version（如 0.2.18）是 Strata 的发布/应用版本；同包内的控制端(control)与推理引擎(engine)各自带内部版本（如 0.2.18 = control 0.1.64 + engine 0.1.64）。三者随同一发布锁步更新，本清单同时下载控制端与引擎，scoop 升级时二者一起换
引擎解到 components\engine\<engine 版本>-windows-x86_64-hip-rdna3，目录名由安装时读取 engine-component.json 生成，升级后自动换新目录
HIP 变体默认按 RDNA3 打包（gfx1100/1101/1102/1151）：RX 7900 XT/XTX/GRE、RX 7800/7700、RX 9070 之前的 7000 系列与 Strix Halo。RX 6000（gfx1030/1031）或 RX 9070/9070 XT（gfx1200/1201）需要换引擎包，见 README
模型（GGUF）不随包分发：先自行准备模型，再用 start-model-visible.ps1 启动
启动：start-model-visible.ps1 -Backend hip（或直接运行 strata-hip）
pre_install: $c = @('@echo off','setlocal','rem Strata (HIP / AMD Radeon) - Scoop build: the engine lives inside this package.','set "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR=%~dp0..\components"','set "STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND=hip"','call "%~dp0strata.cmd" %*','exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%')
Write-Host ('strata: engine left in components\engine\_incoming (unexpected engine identity: ' + $n + ')')
